description: Manage social media DMs and scheduled posts from your AI assistant, across 12 platforms.
name: io.github.azorkai/crmsolid-mcp

environmentVariables.description: CRM Solid API key (csk_...), created under Settings, Developers in the panel.
environmentVariables.name: CRMSOLID_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: API base URL. Defaults to https://api.crmsolid.com; set it for self-hosted or white-label installs.
environmentVariables.name: CRMSOLID_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to expose only read tools and block every write.
environmentVariables.name: CRMSOLID_READ_ONLY

environmentVariables.description: Comma separated allow list of tool names to expose.
environmentVariables.name: CRMSOLID_TOOLS
